title.narrative: Partenariati territoriali per la transizione ecologica in Tunisia: Co-progettazione di processi e pratiche incentrate sulla persona
Territorial partnerships for the ecological transition in Tunisia: Co-design of people-centred processes and practices.

description.narrative: Questa iniziativa si concentra sulla transizione ecologica, una priorità per promuovere l'innovazione verde e creare posti di lavoro in Tunisia, come espresso dalla "Strategia Nazionale di Transizione Ecologica" della Tunisia, e mira a rafforzare le capacità e la dotazione di strumenti e competenze delle istituzioni e delle strutture e centri di educazione, ricerca e formazione per affrontare le sfide ecologiche, mitigare e adattarsi ai cambiamenti climatici, promuovendo al contempo lo sviluppo sostenibile e l'innovazione. Il partenariato incaricato della realizzazione dell’iniziativa include istituzioni accademiche, enti locali, fondazioni e rappresentati della società civile. Il progetto si distingue per due elementi innovativi: un approccio integrato che include educazione superiore, ricerca, formazione professionale, la realizzazione di progetti ecologici pilota e modelli di trasferimento tecnologico in sinergia con il settore privato, e un partenariato multiattore che include enti locali, università, centri di formazione e organizzazioni della società civile tra Italia e Tunisia. Il progetto si struttura in quattro componenti e risultati principali: R1: Governance partecipativa – Attivazione di partenariati territoriali di competenze per facilitare una governance efficace e inclusiva del processo di transizione ecologica. R2: Rafforzamento di competenze – Sviluppo del know-how locale per supportare la transizione ecologica, attraverso programmi di supporto alle strutture di ricerca, educazione superiore e ricerca professionale in un’ottica multilivello e multidisciplinare. R3: Condivisione e sperimentazione – Capitalizzazione di modelli e pratiche innovative per implementare esperienze concrete di eco-innovazione in Tunisia. R4: Valorizzazione della ricerca – Promuovere l'innovazione attraverso la ricerca e il trasferimento tecnologico nel quadro del rafforzamento dell’ecosistema servizi-imprese a beneficio dell’imprenditoria locale.

This initiative focuses on ecological transition, a priority for promoting green innovation and creating jobs in Tunisia, as expressed in Tunisia's ‘National Ecological Transition Strategy’, and aims to strengthen the capacities and equipment of institutions and education, research and training facilities and centres to address ecological challenges, mitigate and adapt to climate change, while promoting sustainable development and innovation. The partnership includes academics, institutions, the private sector and civil society. The project is characterised by two innovative elements: an integrated approach from higher education, research and training to the implementation of innovative ecological projects on a pilot basis; and a multi-stakeholder partnership on territorial basis, including local authorities, universities, training centres and civil society organisations between Italy and Tunisia. The project is structured around the following four components and results: R1: Participatory governance - Activation of territorial skills partnerships to facilitate effective and inclusive governance of ecological transition processes. R2: Capacity-building - Development of local know-how to support ecological transition, through multidisciplinary training programmes. R3: Sharing and experimentation - Capitalisation of innovative models and practices to implement concrete eco-innovation experiences in Tunisia. R4: Enhancement of research - Promoting innovation through research and technology transfer mechanisms as part of the business services ecosystem to support local entrepreneurship in synergy with scientific research.

tag.narrative: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation

By 2020, substantially expand globally the number of scholarships available to developing countries, in particular least developed countries, small island developing States and African countries, for enrolment in higher education, including vocational training and information and communications technology, technical, engineering and scientific programmes, in developed countries and other developing countries
By 2030, achieve the sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources
By 2030, enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and capacity for participatory, integrated and sustainable human settlement planning and management in all countries
By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship
Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels

Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation

Enhance scientific research, upgrade the technological capabilities of industrial sectors in all countries, in particular developing countries, including, by 2030, encouraging innovation and substantially increasing the number of research and development workers per 1 million people and public and private research and development spending
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all
Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns

Increase the access of small-scale industrial and other enterprises, in particular in developing countries, to financial services, including affordable credit, and their integration into value chains and markets
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable

Promote mechanisms for raising capacity for effective climate change-related planning and management in least developed countries and small island developing States, including focusing on women, youth and local and marginalized communities
Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels
Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
